name: Electronic, Optical and Magnetic Properties of Materials
description: Electronic properties: classical conductivity, quantum description of conductivity, effect of alloying in metals, intrinsic and extrinsic semiconductor properties, application of Fermi-Dirac statistics, Fermi level and Hall effect, two probe and four probe measurements, conductive polymers, ionic conductors, superconductors, device applications (diode, Ohmic/Schottky junctions etc.). Dielectric properties: dielectric constant, Maxwell’s equations, complex dielectric constant, frequency dependence, non-linear dielectrics; optical properties: Beer-Lambert’s law, transmittance, reflectivity and conductivity, classical and quantum approach to optical properties, phonons, spectroscopy, luminescence, fluorescence, optical devices (LASERs, LEDs). Magnetic properties: types of magnetism (ferro-, para-, ferri-, dia- and antiferro-), susceptibility, curie temperature, Neel’s temperature, domain structure and magnet design.
